name: engineering-reviewer
description: Graph-based engineering problem generator and mastery reviewer

scripts.test: npm run -s clean:mcqs && npm run -s gen:registry && (node --test --test-reporter=./scripts/quiet_reporter.js test/run_test.js test/run_hygiene_test.js test/derivation_matrix_test.js test/rate_parts_test.js test/patch_test.js test/trace_test.js test/section_d_test.js test/sibling_markup_test.js test/memo_equivalence_test.js test/ctx_test.js test/reporter_test.js > tmp/test_out.txt 2>&1; s=$?; cat tmp/test_out.txt; exit $s)
scripts.audit: npm test && npm run audit:duplicates && npm run audit:dead-code
